command:
set -eu
p=/usr/lib/libteec.so
test -f "$p"; test ! -L "$p"
echo BEFORE
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
wc -c < "$p"
sha256sum "$p"
echo DATA_START
base64 "$p"
echo DATA_END
sha256sum "$p"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
